<hbox align="center">
              <label
                for="externalKey"
                data-l10n-id="openpgp-external-key-label"
              ></label>
              <hbox class="input-container" flex="1">
                <html:input
                  id="externalKey"
                  type="text"
                  class="input-inline"
                  placeholder="0x0123456789ABCDEF"
                  required="required"
                  minlength="16"
                  maxlength="80"
                  pattern="(0x)?(?:(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){4}|(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){10}|(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4} ?){16})(?<![ ])$"
                />
              </hbox>
